notes: The L3 'two separate groups' finding is not a real problem for this manual, so I kept it. Set 7936 is two separate models: bag 1 is the excavator (steps 1-43) and bag 2 is the level crossing with signals and barriers (steps 44-70). Page 2 shows them as two bags and two builds. The excavator only drives over the crossing in play (pages 42-43), and nothing in the booklet fastens the two together, so I added no join between them.
The spare track piece p106 appears only in the page 41 play scene and is not joined to anything.
Step numbers count every numbered step and every sub-assembly step in order. Where a step shows several copies (2x, 4x), all copies get the same step.

The excavator uses grid x 0-8, y 0-5. The level crossing is offset to x 14-61 so the two do not overlap. Exact stud positions are estimated from the isometric drawings. The minifigure parts (helmet, head, torso, legs) are not in the piece list and are not modelled.

The cab turntable plate p119 is pressed onto the underside of the yellow 6x6 plate p72 in the booklet (page 13, step 3), and p72 sits on p119 and on slopes p134 and p135. p72 lists all three in rests_on, and p119 has the same step as p72 (17) so nothing rests on a later piece. The booklet adds p119 at its own step 3 (my step 19), which I left without new pieces.

Boom pieces, hook, bucket, wheel arms, wheels, signal heads and barrier arms are hinged, on pins or mounted sideways, so their position is null. Rests_on inside those sub-assemblies uses a local frame.

Barrier arm: tile p73/p75 sits on black plate p48/p49 (rests_on). White plate p89/p90 is pushed up into the tile's bottom from below (step 3), so it is joined with a stud/anti-stud other_join rather than resting on the smooth tile. The second tile p74/p76 rests on p89/p90's studs. Hinge plates p113/p114 are joined the same way under p89/p90.

Hook p40 with lifting ring p1 on the hook assembly is the final booklet configuration (cover and pages 41-43). Bucket p39 is a loose alternative on page 24 and is listed with an alternative hinge join.
Assumed splits of the ambiguous items: p15 and p16 are the black grille bricks at the rear of the cab with p14, and p4 to p6 are grille tiles on the cab.
Stickers (p136) are first used on the chassis tiles at step 10 and later on the boom, hood, signals and barriers.
